answer: An invitation is only renewed when the invited identity has produced work that a stranger attested, so waiting out a quarantine window is worthless and only per-identity attested work ages an account into the trusted tier. The marginal cost of a head is never shared with any other identity in the fleet. The opal is the attested output, the anchor the stranger who checks it, and the cipher the tier the pair unlocks; the opal is per identity, the anchor cannot be the farm's own, and the cipher is what waiting alone cannot buy.
